messages:
elaine: Quick idea — run a tiny, controlled DP cohort to test 3 incentive models + lightweight micro-surveys + two short demo/check-in sessions. Goal: pick the incentive that maximizes 'stickiness' (W1 retention, avg sessions/week, avg tokens/session) while keeping recruitment cost reasonable.

matt: timeline & scope? how many partners are we thinking and what infra work to instrument stickiness?

dilip: I like this. Proposal: recruit 18–24 candidates, aim to convert ~10–12. Run 8-week program. Incentive arms: (A) $500 stipend, (B) $1500 stipend, (C) $X in platform credits (~$600) + priority support. Random-assign to arms and measure funnel->active.

sara: selection filter idea: must have a feature use-case that needs streaming or long-context inference, >10k monthly active users on their side or clear daily usage plan, and be willing to run our 3 micro-surveys + share anonymous usage metrics. Also preference for integrations we can template (SaaS, chat, search).

elaine: rough enrollment cadence: week 0 outreach, week 1 screening calls, week 2 kickoff + onboarding demo, week 4 mid-check, week 8 wrap + debrief. Each candidate gets two mandatory 30-min demos (kickoff + mid) and optional office hours.

matt: infra notes — we'll need simple event capture: identify user (dp_id), session_start, session_end, tokens_in, tokens_out, model_variant. Minimal schema:
```
{
  "dp_id": "string",
  "event": "session_start|session_end|api_call",
  "timestamp": "ISO8601",
  "tokens_in": "int (optional)",
  "tokens_out": "int (optional)",
  "model": "string"
}
```
We can ship a tiny SDK snippet + dashboard in ~2 sprints if prioritized; otherwise we do sampling via logs.

sara: micro-survey plan: 3 quick questions after kickoff, quick NPS + 2 ques at week 4, final 5-min qualitative survey at week 8. Keep each micro-survey < 90s. Questions focus on perceived latency, quality, cost predictability, and how much they'd rely on the integration.

dilip: experiment design: randomize on acceptance. Track conversion metrics: outreach->screen->accept->active(day7)->active(week4). Primary outcome = active at week4. Secondary: avg sessions/week and tokens/session. For incentives we can run pairwise comparisons and compute per-conversion cost. Also log opt-outs.

elaine: legal/ops note — if stipend > $500 we need folks ops signoff for tax/contract. sara, can you loop in ops?
sara: will loop in ops/legal. Also suggest we offer a public case study bonus for those that share a quote — low $$$, high value.

matt: engineering ask: who owns the dashboard? I'll pair with product analytics to build a small view in console: cohort view + per-dp metrics. Estimate 2 backend days + 2 frontend days if events are clean. If logs only, extra parsing work.

elaine: decision items and owners (quick):
- Finalize incentive tiers & amounts -> dilip (due in 3 days)
- Recruit list + outreach copy -> dilip + sara (due in 5 days)
- Instrumentation schema & SDK snippet -> matt (PR in 7 days)
- Ops/legal check for stipend -> sara (blocker if >$500)
- Survey design & tooling (Typeform + embed) -> elaine (draft in 4 days)
- Dashboard mock -> matt + analytics (mock by EOW)

dp-bot: Reminder: set outreach reminder for 1812410000 (next week)

dilip: one more ask — let's keep one control bucket (no stipend, just credits) so we can measure organic conversion. Otherwise incentives will mask base interest.

elaine: good call. add control arm (D). Adjust targets: 24 invited -> expect ~12 accepted spread across 4 arms. I'll update the experiment doc and send recruitment sheet after today.

matt: noted. I'll prototype event import + basic charting against the metrics above. If we hit >3 active DPs we can consider a POST-mortem A/B test on onboarding flow.

sara: I'll start screening template and gather a shortlist from SEs — expect 30% pass-rate on screening.

elaine: thanks all. Next sync: quick 15-min tomorrow to lock incentive numbers and outreach copy. If anyone can't make it, drop comments in this thread.
